> @honganan Let's wait for a solution here, no matter this should be fixed on skywalking or dubbo.

ok

We did full research on https://github.com/apache/skywalking-java/pull/110, which is ready to merge soon.
I want to update the Dubbo community, this is a bug for sure. We are using a bypass to check whether it is a provider side or a consumer side, and avoid using the native context's status only.

But this would affect other users too. It is better Dubbo could fix this. SkyWalking community will keep in this bypass solution, to make sure all existing previous releases(before your fix) could work well with our agent.
